title: Smoky Uni Sushi
description: A fusion sushi dish combining smoky flavors with the freshness of uni.

ingredients.name: Smoky sauce
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika and chili flakes mixed with soy sauce

ingredients.name: Uruguayan chimichurri
ingredients.notes: Herbs and spices mixed with olive oil

instructions: Prepare sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the uni into small pieces and set aside.
Prepare the smoky sauce by mixing smoked paprika, chili flakes, and soy sauce in a small bowl.
Cut the jazz jalapeño into thin slices.
Prepare the Uruguayan chimichurri by mixing herbs and spices with olive oil in a small bowl.
Lay a sheet of sushi nori flat and spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto it.
Place a few pieces of uni in the middle of the rice.
Drizzle the smoky sauce over the uni.
Top with a slice of jazz jalapeño.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat.
Repeat the process to make multiple sushi rolls.
Serve with a side of Uruguayan chimichurri sauce.
